Decisión incorrecta. El examinador médico clasificó la muerte como un accidente, pero los detectives que investigaron el caso declararon que la evidencia en la escena indicaba lo contrario.

Línea Final. En 1994, Rhoda Nathan fue encontrada asesinada en una habitación de un hotel en Cincinnati.

CSI.us: Grissom Versus The Volcano. The sheriff is under political pressure to find who killed an air marshal with a car bomb that the sheriff witnessed.
Coming Of Rage. A teenager is found murdered on a construction site. Grissom, Sara, and Warrick follow the lead of blood on a hammer.
Eleven Angry Jurors. The lone holdout on a jury is found dead in the jury room. The eleven jurors who were voting guilty and who hated the dead juror are the natural suspects.
Butterflied. A woman found murdered in her home. Her resemblance to Sara causes Grissom to take a personal interest in the case and forces him to examine the decisions he has made in his life.
Suckers. Grissom, Sara, and Nick respond to an electrocution at a casino. The casino is hosting Japanese antiquities. The electrocution is just a ruse to steal the central piece of the exhibit.
Paper Or Plastic?. A robbery at a grocery store results in a shootout leaving five dead. The police officer at the scene believes Grissom has a grudge against him.
Early Rollout. The whole team must investigate a crime where a husband and his porn star wife were murdered execution-style.
Getting Off. Catherine and Sara deal with the death of what at first seems to be a transvestite.

Bad To The Bone. A violent murder in a casino parking garage and another episode in the police interview room lead the CSIs to one shocking discovery after another.

Bad Words. Warrick, Catherine, and Nick try to determine the cause of a house fire that kills a teenage girl. The fire is in the same neighborhood as a similar arson fire. Grissom and Sara investigate

Turn Of The Screws. A roller coaster runs off its track, leaving six people dead. The CSI team investigates whether this was an accident or foul play.
No More Bets. Two young men are found murdered after scamming Sam Braun's casinos.

Tras el espectáculo. El encaprichamiento de un sospechoso con Catherine hace que ésta se haga cargo de un caso de alto perfil.

Miembros furiosos de un jurado. El único miembro del jurado que se resistía a votar aparece muerto en la sala del jurado. Los once jurados que votaban culpable y que odiaban al jurado muerto son los s
Amariposado. Una mujer aparece asesinada en su casa. Su parecido con Sara hace que Grissom se interese personalmente por el caso y le obliga a examinar las decisiones que ha tomado en su vida.

Incautos. Grissom, Sara y Nick responden a una electrocución en un casino. El casino alberga antigüedades japonesas. La electrocución no es más que una treta para robar la pieza central de la exposici

Levantarse temprano. Todo el equipo debe investigar un crimen en el que un marido y su esposa, estrella del porno, fueron asesinados al estilo ejecución.
Desengancharse. Catherine y Sara se enfrentan a la muerte de lo que al principio parece ser un travesti.
DeadlyWomen.us: Obsession. Deciphering what causes minds to corkscrew out of control is the complex work of the criminal profiler. Obsessions can take many forms: beauty, devotion, ego and power.
Under His Control. These are love stories with bleak, bloody endings. Blinded by desire, obsessed and malleable, some women fall into lethal relationships with dangerous, controlling men.
Teen Killers. They were too young to drink or vote but they were not too young to commit the most brutal of crimes. Some were driven by pure curiosity: how would it feel to take a life?
The Sacred Bond. Women who kill husbands, lovers, rivals and parents will shock society. But a very special horror is reserved for women who will kill their own.
Dark Secrets. Judi Buenoano secretly murdered lovers to claim on insurance policies whilst nurse Genene Jones secretly killed at least 46 infants left in her care between 1980 and 1982.
Till Death Do Us Part. While marriage is meant to be for life, it often ends in divorce. These wives took their marriages vow seriously: "till death do us part."
Fortune Hunters. Greed is one of the oldest motives for murder, and these deadly women are no exception: they’ll do anything to satisfy their need for cash. This is the dangerous world of the fortune
Lethal Lovers. Psychopathic killers lurk in society, mostly acting alone. Sometimes fate brings them into contact with another person who shares their cold power to kill.

Blood Lines. Blood ties are strong ties, sometimes strong enough to pull a person into a murderous conspiracy. When a family member wields his or her power, the result can be death.
Greed. Known as “black widows,” these women kill their spouses, lovers and children for profit. Murder for them becomes a business. Their trade is murder. Their profit? Blood money.

Behind the Mask. Behind lace-curtained windows and beneath sensible haircuts lurked evil. Appearances were deceptive. We did not notice these female killers walking by. These women wore a mask of sani
Bad Medicine. Nurse Beverley Allitt overdosed multiple infants, Stella Nickell poisoned medicine capsules in stores and Kathleen Follbigg killed four of her own children.
